segment_breakdown.purpose: Show audience/market composition as % across several categories with icons
segment_breakdown.slots: title; 3-4 category groups each [icon, %, label]; 1 highlight stat [label,value]; optional mini-chart

resource_links.purpose: Point readers to related resources/dashboards as labelled link tiles
resource_links.slots: title; 4 link tiles each [icon, label]; contact line; optional visual

text_stats_picture_right.purpose: Explain a topic with supporting stats beside a full-height photo
text_stats_picture_right.slots: title; body paragraph; 2 stats [value, caption]; full-height picture right

icon_columns_5.purpose: Lay out 4-6 parallel pillars/items as an icon row
icon_columns_5.slots: eyebrow; title; intro; 5 items each [icon, text]

chart_commentary.purpose: Present a chart with interpretive commentary columns
chart_commentary.slots: subtitle; title; chart + highlight stat; 2-3 comment columns [heading, text]

statement_links.purpose: Closing statement with grouped resource links
statement_links.slots: statement title; intro; 3 link groups [heading, links]; icon

lifecycle_4stage.purpose: Show an end-to-end lifecycle/process across 4 connected stages with header image
lifecycle_4stage.slots: header image; eyebrow; title; 4 stages each [icon, heading, bullets] on a connected axis

two_picture_compare.purpose: Compare two themes/options, each with a picture and points

numbered_summary_picture.purpose: Recap 3 key points as a numbered list beside a full-height photo
numbered_summary_picture.slots: title; 3 items [number, text]; full-height picture right

three_picture_cards.purpose: Present three options/benefits as picture cards

quote_context.purpose: Customer quote with supporting context and attribution
quote_context.slots: label; context paragraph; big quote; attribution

offer_cta.purpose: Present an offer/price with fine print and a call-to-action, header image
offer_cta.slots: header image; title; price + fine print; CTA box [heading, text, icon]

four_point_value.purpose: Introduce a concept via a 4-point value grid with supporting images
four_point_value.slots: eyebrow; title; 4 points [number, heading, text]; 2 images

how_it_works_3step.purpose: Explain how something works in 3 numbered steps with header image

numbered_icon_row_6.purpose: Present up to 6 sequential items as a numbered icon row

quarterly_plan_4col.purpose: Lay out a plan across 4 quarters with supporting columns
quarterly_plan_4col.slots: subtitle; title; intro; 4 columns; 4 quarter blocks [quarter, items]

comparison_table.slots: title; column headers; N rows x M columns

hero_stat.purpose: One dominant headline number as the whole message
hero_stat.slots: eyebrow; huge value; caption; supporting line

image_section_divider.purpose: Section divider with a full-bleed image and overlaid title
